spans.s:
White.
2

Yellow.
3

Pale red: (or it may be used as a noun substantive mas. to imply either of these colours.)
4 Clean, cleansed, pure.
m. (-रः)
1 White mustard.
2 The moon.
3 A tree, (Grislea tomentosa): see धव.
4 A name of CAITANYA.
n. (-रं)
1 The filament of a lotus.
2

Gold.
3

Saffron.
f. (-रा or री)
1 A name of the goddess PĀRVATĪ.
(-री)
2 A young girl, eight years old.
3 Any young girl prior to menstruation, a maid, a virgin.
4 The name of a river.
5 The wife of the deity VARUṆ

The earth.
7

Turmeric.
8
A yellow die called

Gorocanā.
9

A plant: see रोचनी.
10 A plant bearing a fragrant seed: see प्रियङ्गु.
11 One of the female energies or Śaktis of the

Bauddhas.
12

A white kind of Dūrbbā or bent grass.
13 Arabian jasmin.
14 Sacred basil or

Tulasi.
15

One of the Rāgiṇīs.
E.
गुड to sound, and रन् Uṇādi affix, the deriv. is irregular; also गुरी to endeavour, घञ् affix, and derivative irr.; upon whom or what the mind exerts itself; again, गौर white, pure, &c. affix ङीष्, that which is white or brilliant, &c. which applies to the virgin, &c.

m. (-न्द्रः)
A name of the saint CAITANYA.

n. (-वं)
1 Reputation, respectability, venerableness or weight.
2 Physical weight, heaviness.
E.
गुरु heavy, respectable, &c. and अण् affix, implying condition of being.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Venerable, respectable.
E.
गौरव, and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Praised, famed, celebrated.
E.
गौरव fame, and ईरित declared.

m. (-कः)
A species of bassia; also धूमल.
E.
गौर pale white, and शाक a potherb.

m. (-पः)
1 White mustard.
2 The white mustard seed considered as a measure of weight.
E.
गौर white, and सर्षप mustard; also गौर.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A name of CAITANYA.
E.
गौर pale, and अङ्ग body.

m. (-कः)
A kind of poison.
E.
गौर white, and आर्द्रक ginger.

m. (-स्यः)
A black monkey with a white face.
E.
गौर, and आस्थ face.

f. (-का)
A virgin, a young girl, one eight years old, or in whom menstruation has not commenced.
E.
गौरी as above, and कन् aff.

m. (-लः)
1 White mustard.
2 Iron or steel filings or dust.
E.
गौर pale white, and इलच् aff.

m. (-जः)
KĀRTTIKEYA or GAṆEŚA.
n. (-जं)
Tale.
E.
गौरी, and ज born.

m. (-ट्टः)
The horizontal plate of the Liṅga, typical of the female organ.
E.
गौरी, and पट्ट a layer.

m. (-तिः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
गौरी, and पति husband.

m. (-त्त्रः)
A name of the deity KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
गौरी the goddess, and पुत्र a son, the son of GAURĪ.

n. (-तं)
Yellow orpiment.
E.
गौरी the goddess, or a young girl, and ललित loved, liked; this being used as a dye to stain the clothes of women, &c.

m. (-कः)
A violator of the bed of a Guru.
E.
गुरु, तल्प a bed, and ठञ् aff.
